# Revert profile (`profile.revert`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Flow · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** no

Undoes an active profile, restoring the settings it changed. Does nothing if the profile is not active.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | text | yes |  | Id of the profile to revert. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: profile.revert
    profile: gaming
```
